method.approach: V5 precedent reused (research/control/forex_free_v5_run/d2_a7_novelty_evidence/compute_schedule_rhos.py): reconstruct signed decision-exposure schedules from frozen rules + conditioning clocks + staged prices; compare with Spearman rho variants, Jaccard overlap, sign agreement. Measured, never argued; no PnL consulted (none exists).
method.exposure_cell_convention: cell (decision_date, pair, side) iff the book holds the position at that date's 16:00 America/New_York close instant; opened at close(f), closed at close(x) -> cells f..x-1; applied identically to both sides of every comparison. A +/-1-session alternative convention was measured (convention_sensitivity.json): no pooled rho moved by more than ~0.03 and no verdict changes.
method.gate_statistic: per proposal: max |Spearman rho| over the POOLED signed exposure-series variants (cellwise_signed_full_grid, cellwise_union_active, netsigned_union_dates_shared_pairs) across ALL forbidden ancestors. Rationale: RULES 2.4 'pooled |rho|'; V5 precedent conventions (its PASS cases measured pooled signed variants; its reported strongly-NEGATIVE fire rho was recorded as an anti-coincidence novelty signal and excluded from the max; its KILL used a proposal-disclosed pooled overlap region). Fire/0-1 indicators are not signed exposure series and never gate. Conditional co-firing rho and ancestor-support-restricted pooled rho are computed, reported, and flagged when over the bar, but do not gate (they are post-hoc domain restrictions; the V5 kill's overlap region was disclosed by that packet, none was disclosed here).
method.decision_close_series: 16:00 America/New_York completed weekday closes derived from the staged H1 snapshots (zoneinfo DST-correct, 20:00Z EDT / 21:00Z EST). The provider 1day bars are NOT the decision-close series (measured median |close ratio - 1| = 0.0020 vs the 16:00-NY close on 1721 overlap days).
method.coverage_note: the staged H1 snapshots begin 2020-01-30; no evidenced 16:00-NY decision close exists before that date. ALL schedules (proposals AND ancestors) produce no cells before it, so every comparison is measured on the shared observable span inside S0 2018-04-04..2025-07-24. The truncation is comparison-neutral but changes absolute event populations (finding F1).

ancestor_definitions.V5_window_avoidance_anchor: FXFV5-A6-P1 anchor law verbatim from research/assets/forex_free_v5/family_a6p1.py: F = last 16:00-NY bar strictly before the clock's availability instant, D = one session before F, X = first bar strictly after; direction = -sign(sum of the 10 log returns strictly before D); enter at F's decision instant, exit at X's; exposure F..X-1; warmup 11 closes, S0 cap, one-event lag 4 days, one-position governor; built on the V5 clock file (the ancestor's own semantics, v2 CA stamps). Fold force-flat machinery excluded (scoring-phase structure; 2 internal boundaries — recorded ambiguity).
ancestor_definitions.V5_sham_shadow: same law with availability + 7 calendar days; window dropped iff any evidenced clock instant of ANY economy lies strictly inside it (sham_dropped=23); V5-precedent construction.
ancestor_definitions.carry_region: direction = sign(day-start as-of policy-rate differential, BIS-evidenced ledger rows, availability AND effective-date gated) on all 7 staged pairs. Primary: UNCONDITIONAL always-in book (widest form of the region, 'vol-gated or not'). Sensitivity: a disclosed daily-return-std reconstruction of the V3 vol gate (20-day blocks x 10, 220-day warmup, LOW iff S_T < B_T) — labelled recon, estimator reading documented.
ancestor_definitions.session_families: the four intraday session shapes are NOT daily-clock observable; reconstructed as daily-clock exposure-shape proxies with disclosed rules: london_open_continuation = continue prior decision day's move; late_ny_fade = fade current day's move; tokyo_london_expansion = continuation on days |r| > trailing-20-day median |r|; london_am_break = continuation in the day's direction. Structural proxies only — recorded as an interpretation limit.
ancestor_definitions.commodity_bloc_risk_off: FXFV4-A6-P1 anchor reconstruction per V5 precedent: S_t = 0.5*(r_AUD + r_NZD - r_USDCAD), z <= -1.0 vs trailing 60 completed days strictly before t, frozen 5-leg map, 5-session hold entered next session (trigger-day and exposure-cell schedules both measured).
ancestor_definitions.intra_set: the four proposals vs each other with the identical machinery (6 pairwise).

method.no_pnl_statement: NO PnL, no costs, no financing, no scored output, no fills beyond schedule instants were computed or consulted anywhere in this audit. No scored_*.json, execution report, or terminal verdict file was read. Only schedule-level arithmetic exists in this lane.

verdicts.recorded_diagnostics: OVER THE BAR AS NON-GATING DIAGNOSTICS: co-held sign agreement 0.9574 vs V5_sham (n=47) and 0.9412 vs V5_anchor (n=51); support-restricted pooled rho 0.4934/0.4669. Kinship recorded for ranking; the conditioning gate, not the direction rule, is the family's identifying claim and its neighbour/placebo falsifiers target exactly it.

findings.directed_at: A9 feasibility lane (not a novelty failure)
findings.finding: The staged H1 snapshots begin 2020-01-30. No evidenced 16:00-NY decision close exists before that date, so every schedule in this audit (proposals and ancestors alike) is truncated to the observable span. The proposals' claimed fold populations (A4P1 90/78/78, A4P2 99/81/84 pre-skip) assumed full-S0 price coverage; measured on the staged span, A4P1's anchor fold populations are 28/72/76 — fold 1 is BELOW its own >= 30/fold non-vacuity gate as staged. A6P1 approx-thirds 26/29/32 and A6P2 570/1095/1040 cells clear their floors. The provider 1day series reaches back to 2018-09 but is NOT the 16:00-NY decision-close series (median close deviation 0.20%, max 4.33%) and cannot be silently substituted (P-1/P-3). A9 must adjudicate feasibility on the staged span or surface the coverage gap to the owner; no rescue inside D2.

findings.severity: HIGH (recorded; non-gating under the frozen pooled gate)
findings.finding: A6P1 carries the mirror image of the V5 sham shadow on the shadow's own book: support-restricted pooled |rho| 0.4223 and co-held conditional |rho| 0.6064 (sign agreement 0.1948, n=77, containment 0.4813) — both above the 0.20 bar as measured diagnostics. The pooled whole-book gate (0.1781) passes by 0.0219 — the thinnest margin in the wave. Under the doctrine's most-adverse-formulation posture (V5 bar_declaration) an auditor applying the ancestor-support formulation directly would record ANCESTRY_VETO vs the sham shadow; this audit's frozen gate excludes post-hoc domain restrictions (none was packet-disclosed, unlike the V5 A6P2 kill) and therefore records PASS-with-conditions. Both readings are reported so the selector cannot be surprised by either.

findings.severity: HIGH (recorded; non-gating under the frozen pooled gate)
findings.finding: A6P2 shares the V5 family's DIRECTION LAW: on the cells where both hold, sign agreement is 0.9574 with the V5 sham shadow (n=47) and 0.9412 with the V5 anchor (n=51); support-restricted pooled |rho| 0.4934/0.4669. Mechanically expected: both fade the ~10-day trailing move. The pooled schedules decorrelate (0.0877/0.0856) because the CONDITIONING (dollar-factor PCA concentration, calendar-free, 7 pairs) is genuinely absent from the ancestors. The family's identifying claim is the conditioning gate, and its preregistered neighbour + placebo falsifiers target exactly that claim — noted so the selector reads the falsifiers as the load-bearing structure.

Measured intra-set duplication: FXFV6-A6-P1's exposure book is a strict subset of FXFV6-A4-P1's (containment 1.000, 435/435 cells; pooled signed rho 0.2502/0.3072, both above the bar; same direction 67.8%). Funding both would double-count one mechanism against the six-cell budget. AT MOST ONE of {A4P1, A6P1} is fundable; the audit's DOA recommendation is FXFV6-A6-P1 (contained subset; thinnest novelty margin 0.0219; carries F2). This mirrors the V5 precedent's A4-P1/A4-P2 conditional co-funding clause.

A4P1's 5-session holds subsume 96.9% of the V5 sham shadow's exposure cells (timing subsumption without direction identity: co-held agreement 0.4065, conditional rho -0.1826, support-restricted -0.1811, all under the bar; pooled gate 0.1235). Arithmetic, not coincidence: 5 decision sessions from the day after a release span 7 calendar days across weekends, swallowing the +7d sham window of the same clock. Recorded so the ranking criterion 'lowest measured max-|rho|' is read together with the containment context.

A6P1's compression state (rv5 <= 0.9*rv20) is off or dead-zoned on 89 of 182 in-span clocks (48.9%) — the anchor is state-throttled; measured event populations 26/29/32 per approx-third. Its >= 15/arm/fold floor clears as staged, with thin headroom in fold 2 (29).

Sham/control runnability: ALL FOUR proposals' mandatory controls RUN under the same evidenced semantics with non-vacuous populations and >= 79% of anchor counts (A4P1 sham 174/176; A4P2 sham 190/194; A6P1 sham 95/87; A6P2 placebo 446/541 leg-entries, ratio 0.824 — above the 50% control-identifiability floor). NO design failure on control runnability anywhere in the wave. CA boundary rows respected (3 CA events conditionable only at their published available_for_daily_decision_date); AU gaps fail closed (no clock rows exist pre-Sep-2019 / mid-2022 and none was invented).
